newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan opposition jets bomb Kabul, one killed.
newsitem.headline: Afghan opposition jets bomb Kabul, one killed.

text.p: At least one person was killed and five wounded when opposition jets bombed the residential areas of Afghanistan's capital Kabul on Saturday night, a Pakistan-based Afghan news agency said on Sunday.
The Afghan Islamic Press (AIP) said two opposition jets bombed the capital twice in midnight raids targeting the presidential palace and residential areas.
"One bomb fell close to the presidential palace causing damage to the windows," the AIP said.
It said one person was killed and five suffered serious wounds when a bomb hit a residential area.
The AIP said the opposition forces were still holding the Bagram air base, north of Kabul, which they re-captured on Friday night after losing it to Islamic Taleban militia a few hours earlier.
